notes.title: 2022: Rewind
notes.content:
It's officially 2023 and we've been doing some reflecting on this past year! Rocket Rumble has come a long way since last New Years and with tons happening on the horizon, we thought we'd look back at our journey in 2022! 

[h3]New Year, New Logo[/h3]
2022 came with a brand new Logo for the game! It's bright and fun and we think it's a huge improvement from our previous logo! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/e5e5506886ee1e999589ba493216f6fd54e2420b.png[/img]

[h3]Seasonal Events[/h3]
This past year came with 3 in game events where players collect candy and trade them in for exclusive rewards in the Rocket Rumble shop! Rewards include accessories for your characters and your Rocket Rumble profile! 

[i]"Love Struck" (Valentines event) - Feb 2022
"Harrowing Halloween" (Halloween event) - October 2022
"Holiday Hustle" (Winter event) - December 2022[/i]

Both Harrowing Halloween and Holiday Hustle included the possibility to grab 2021's seasonal loot as well as brand new holiday exclusives! 

[b]You can check out the stream from our latest event here: [/b]

[previewyoutube=4Fb9dkVWkB0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]First Birthday! [/h3]
Rocket Rumble celebrated it's first birthday this past year on August 3rd and what a difference a year can make! We were really excited with our progress for that short amount of time! 

[h3]In-Person Events[/h3]
This past year, we were fortunate enough to be able to attend some in-person events and conventions! 

[b]DreamHack Dallas:[/b] We had an absolute blast in Texas! So many kind folks came by the Rocket Rumble booth and we had a great time with all of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/98fa4734bc96aa51e6c26b35b24cca64d9b4e899.png[/img]

[b]Pocket Gamer Connects Toronto:[/b] Back in early July we headed off to Toronto for the Pocket Gamer Connects Conference! Especially after Covid, it was an awesome change to chat and exchange feedback with other developers - some of which we hadn’t seen in years and some we’d only met online prior to this! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/b72914c7fd05773943660d50a97c1468cdf2850e.png[/img]

[b]Gamescom Cologne:[/b] Going to Gamescom was like a dream come true! Even though the airline lost our tradeshow luggage and it was a nightmare trying to get it back, we met so many amazing developers and gamers from all over the world and would do it all again in a heartbeat! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/225d67a669d3b0e8bc7bc90232ae66ed434d5f95.png[/img]

[b]Tokyo Game Show: [/b]By far the furthest we've taken Rocket Rumble, TGS was an absolutely incredible experience! Our team had so much fun in Japan meeting gamers and other developers, and we would definitely love to head there again in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/26dac963071d7923b38577ea4a372929e9c9ecbe.png[/img]

[b]ISNS Game Showcase at Halcon:[/b] Our producer is originally from Halifax NS and maintains a close relationship to the game development community there, so we were included in the ISNS Game Showcase at Halcon! This amazing showcase was to highlight work from Nova Scotian developers and it was a ton of fun! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/9162ed7b82350c1296c764b9b5cf73ff3e5235eb.png[/img]

[b]Day of the Devs:[/b] We were honoured to be included in this year's Day of the Devs in San Francisco in California! It was the event's 10th anniversary and with around 70 games involved, it was an amazing time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/d565d91c51f441058fbfac82bacd7688e7dc3c61.png[/img]

[h3]Online Events  [/h3]
Rocket Rumble was also fortunate enough to be included in a number of online festivals and events in 2022!

[i]Indie Live Expo
GLITCH Future of Play Direct
Hand Eye Society Super Festival
Steam Racing Fest
Ontario Creates - Play the North
DreamHack Beyond
Devgamm Gamedev Showcase[/i]

[h3]Game Development World Championship[/h3]
We're so excited to say we placed 4th in June (2022) in the Game Development World Championship! A lot of this was thanks to your votes, so from everyone on the Rocket Rumble team, thank you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/3bf942ed30cb0d1b10d6f03d003be750fd4b4351.png[/img]

[h3]New Streamers[/h3]
We're pleased to say we had several new streamers join our Ambassadors program in 2022! You can check them all out on our [url=https://www.rocketrumblegame.com/ambassadors]website! [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/84fe823fc545897d3d10fdfcb4d19b4240da03a2.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
Rocket Rumble saw a number of updates in 2022! From new UI and VFX to tracks being altered and changed, we're really focused on creating the best user experience! By popular demand, we also included a brand new powerup (the "Sugar Rush")

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/a11fc91a61ad602289d6e1e7d43f438d6ee0fde7.png[/img]

[h3]Voice Actors[/h3]
One of the most exciting changes for Rocket Rumble in 2022 was the addition of voice actors. Bark and meow to your heart's content now that each character comes to life with their own "voices"! 

[h2]What's coming in 2023..[/h2]
We're so excited for this upcoming year! The most exciting news is Rocket Rumble is coming out of Early Access (TBD). We're so close to the end of development and we can't wait to share the finished project with all of you! 

[b]The full launch will include:[/b]
[i]Consoles
New tracks
New characters
Updated menus
New music
More cosmetic items
More profile items
and more! 
[/i]

Since it's a brand new year, be sure to grab this year's New Years headband in the Rocket Rumble shop with code: [b]HAPPY2023[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/90b3df29fbc96695740347b7b7612c9df488fff5.png[/img]

2022 was an incredible year and we can't wait to share more of Rocket Rumble's progress as we reach the final stage of development! 

[i]See you at the start line,[/i]


-Rocket Rumble Team

notes.title: Fall Update
notes.content:
[h3]Rocket Rumble just got an update! [/h3]

We've been working hard on making changes and improvements before our full release (TBD).  We've still got lots to do but you can check out the recent changes to Rocket Rumble here:


[h3]Rocket Rumble Version 0.2.78 Updates[/h3]

[list]
[*] New sound effects
[*] All characters now have voices!
[*] Added additional button prompts and improved existing ones 
[*] Improvements to In race Character Icons in the HUD
[*] Loading screen is fixed when exiting the game
[*] Fixed bug with tutorial crashing the game
[*] Customization Scroll bar now works as intended
[*] Disconnecting from our online servers no longer softlocks the game on the Splash screen
[*] When the Player indicator is active in options, all local players will have nametags above them during gameplay at all times. Hopefully this should help players keep track of where they are
[*] You can no longer get points for damaging yourself with your own items
[*] Killing a player with an item now rewards 4 points instead of 2
[*] Projectiles are now effected with the Boost pads in Holo Night
[*] Fixed bugs with the demo version of the game.
[*] Fixed bug where you could load multiple tracks at once from the Character Select
[*] Added custom Keybind Menu back into the options.
[*] Minor and Major internal bug fixes
[*] ...and, wait who are those shadowy figures on the Character Select?!

[/list]
[h3]Sad Updates:[/h3]

Removed Ghost Dog Pin from last years Halloween event due to a conflict. Players who had this item will receive an in game currency reward automatically

notes.title: September Dev Blog
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Rocket Rumblers! [/h2]

As we continue on our path to full release, we're keen to share what we've been working on! It's been a busy few months and we've accomplished a lot! 

[h3]A New Look![/h3]
Rocket Rumble now has a brand new look on Steam! Check out our new cover art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/2fa4b4fca5a69b590c2bf771fc06aaf053ea4cfd.png[/img]

We also got a brand new icon! So be sure to look for image in your Steam library! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/b37f0e30ebe778d20e0fddccb7a81f2e311013d9.png[/img]

[h3]New Content Creators[/h3]

We have over 40 content creators in our Ambassador Program. You can see *most* of them on our [url=https://www.rocketrumblegame.com/ambassadors]website[/url]! There's still some more to be added to this page, coming soon! Be sure to keep them on your radar for our launch because they'll have goodies to give away! 

[url=https://www.rocketrumblegame.com/ambassadors][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/d674e8457525891cfc34576595375ac7131f5b27.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Gamescom[/h3]

We recently had the opportunity to go to Cologne Germany for Gamescom 2022! Although we were delayed by a whole 24 hours and they lost our luggage with all of our tradeshow goodies, we had an amazing time! We got to meet a ton of amazing people including some very talented developers and we were so fortunate so many folks wanted to stop by our booth and check out Rocket Rumble! We had a blast watching everyone play! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/225d67a669d3b0e8bc7bc90232ae66ed434d5f95.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/7c1b92bf0b581cc5e34df7a257a3598d63659d94.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/d6ca2c9b8d7cb76e51100ce50138096219b68ca7.png[/img]

The top score of the weekend was 177! Think you can beat it? Let us know on Twitter or Instagram! 

You can read about our full Gamescom experience with all of the ups and downs on our [url=https://www.rocketrumblegame.com/post/our-experience-at-gamescom-2022]website[/url]! 

[h3]New Levels[/h3]

Gamescom attendees were among the first to get to check out our Indie Circuit track! This level is one of our shortest, but it's action-packed! We took inspiration from classic car racing circuits so this level has obstacles in the form of pylons, tires, and other items you might find on a racetrack! It also has changing weather, from sun to snow to rain, and features graffiti and signs from some of our favorite studios and content creators! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/7e3c9e54b29c8793091f6822e1278e7e52665214.png[/img]

[h3]Tokyo Game Show[/h3]
We were also excited to be able to attend this year's Tokyo Game Show! Our team had a ton of fun bringing Rocket Rumble to Japan and seeing all the other amazing games at the convention! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/26dac963071d7923b38577ea4a372929e9c9ecbe.png[/img]

We did find a few little bugs while we were at these conventions, so once those are sorted we'll be able to share the track with all of you! So keep a look out for this track coming in the future! 

We're also working on changes to the score screen and the menus, so stay tuned for more updates, coming soon!


See you at the start line,


-Rocket Rumble Team

notes.title: Birthday Update!
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/cd299fa4174ac258fb6e530667fcce147e94b006.png[/img]

This update also comes with a whole list of changes and improvements!
[list]
[*] New Logo
[*] New Race HUD
[*] Player Indicators based on Shape (for better accessibility) 
[*] Menu Mouse Support Added for both keyboard and Gamepad Players
[*] New Sound Effects (Did that dog just talk?!)
[*] New Powerup "Sugar Rush"

[/list]


Stay tuned for more news and updates on the way! Until then, we'll see you at the start line! 


-Rocket Rumble Team

notes.title: July Dev Blog
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Rocket Rumblers! [/h2]

It’s been a while since we’ve done a blog post, but it’s not because we haven’t been busy! Over these past couple months we’ve been working on new tracks, new characters, new power ups and a ton of visual upgrades. Plus we’ve been hitting the road conventions! So strap in - we’ve got a lot to talk about!

[h3]New Tracks are in the Works! [/h3]

We’ve got 4 more tracks in progress on top of the 4 we have now! We won’t share too much just yet but we’re really excited with how they’re turning out! Our Steampunk inspired track is coming along like clockwork and our next 3 tracks are just as exciting! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/0181bb989d024fd95f42220642c8fc5762f26abb.gif[/img]

[h3]More Characters are Coming![/h3]

We love our faithful cast of animal racers, but we’re excited to say there will be more coming with our full release (TBA). Just like our current cast, new characters will be fully customizable with accessories, suit patterns and all the color options you can imagine! 

[h3]More Power Ups! [/h3]

We’ve been working on a brand new power up for Rocket Rumble. We had a lot of feedback asking for a boost item - so consider it in the works! Here’s a little teaser of what’s to come:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/a11fc91a61ad602289d6e1e7d43f438d6ee0fde7.png[/img]

[h3]A New Look![/h3]

You may have seen that we got a brand new logo! We’re really excited with this new branding and we’d love to hear your thoughts! Let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/7JH9ZKT]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/PixelNAUTSgames]Twitter[/url] what you think of this big update to our logo! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/e5e5506886ee1e999589ba493216f6fd54e2420b.png[/img]

Plus, we’re in the process of changing some of the menus and UI elements in-game! We won’t spoil too much just yet but we’re confident it will make a big difference to the gameplay! 

[h2]Hitting the Road..[/h2]

We’ve been fortunate enough to be included in a few festivals so far this summer! It started with the Indie Live Expo and Glitch Future of Play Direct - 2 online events celebrating indie games. We then hit the road to Dallas and Toronto for DreamHack and Pocket Gamer Connects! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/6e253ffa6283747d3f640f50cbc75114a5b56edc.png[/img]

Back in June, we were off to Dallas in June to bring Rocket Rumble to DreamHack! We had an absolute blast at the convention, meeting a TON of amazing people and getting a ton of great feedback! The best part was getting to see everyone’s game faces while they checked out the game! We managed to grab a few shots: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/98fa4734bc96aa51e6c26b35b24cca64d9b4e899.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/2969d7e1a0bea08013251b3ff78d966c52bf18fe.png[/img]

Back in early July we headed off to Toronto for the Pocket Gamer Connects Conference! Especially after Covid, it was an awesome change to chat and exchange feedback with other developers - some of which we hadn’t seen in years and some we’d only met online prior to this! We managed to grab a couple shots from this as well:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/b72914c7fd05773943660d50a97c1468cdf2850e.png[/img]

[h3]Sci-Fi on the Rock[/h3]

We also made a little appearance at this year’s Sci-Fi on the Rock in St. John’s Newfoundland! It’s always awesome when conventions want to support indie game studios so we’re super thankful for the spot! Keep an eye out on our social media for news and updates about upcoming events and conventions! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/54c2534dd72e9be00186b9bba4a27476ff47402e.png[/img]

[h3]Game Development World Championship[/h3]
We're excited to announce we were awarded 4th place for the month of June! This was largely in thanks to everyone who supported and liked our page! You can like our page too and check out the other amazing games involved in the contest by checking out the [url=https://thegdwc.com/games/RocketRumble]GDWC website[/url]! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/3bf942ed30cb0d1b10d6f03d003be750fd4b4351.png[/img]
[h3]New Ambassadors[/h3]

We're pleased to share we have a ton of new content creators involved with our Ambassador program! Stay tuned for some exciting announcements about that coming soon! If you or someone you know are interested in creating content for Rocket Rumble, send us an email: community@pixelnauts.ca 

We can't wait to share more soon so keep an eye out! 
See you at the start line! 





[b]-Rocket Rumble Team[/b]

notes.title: May Dev Blog
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone! [/h2]

It's been a while but we've been really busy these past few months working towards our full release! Check out these awesome updates plus get a peek at what's on the way! 

[h2]Lighting Overhaul[/h2]
We've updated the lighting on 3 of our current tracks! Asteroid Field, Holo Night and Caustic Canyon all got an eyepopping upgrade! These changes are available in our current build! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/31dccd930a4bbe75e7ab71782a37eff530474290.png[/img]

[h2]New VFX![/h2] 
We've added brand new jet trails on the characters and updated some effects in the game, giving Rocket Rumble a brand new look! Plus check out a brand new finish line animation! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/e91b8505c496d720afd00e835884c7e6f29d036b.png[/img]

[h2]Holo Night Update[/h2]
Holo Night finally features procedurally generated obstacles! Now you'll never have the same race twice on this track with an ever-changing layout! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/f0f6a7877fc41ac4acd6af33e65674763afd040a.png[/img]

[h2]Profile Preview[/h2]
Now you can check out your profile banners and frames in a stylish new preview! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/252a0851845c31a339584e8a231396e5f03a4b6a.png[/img]

[h1]On the Horizon...[/h1]

[h2]PixelNAUTS Account System[/h2]
We're working on adding a PixelNAUTS account system to the game! This way you'll be able to save your progress across platforms once we have our full launch next year! 

[h2]Profile Pictures[/h2]
Profile pictures are coming to Rocket Rumble! Along with our new account system, we'll be adding profile avatars to the game. Instead of using Steam profile pictures by default, avatars will added to the game as regular items so you'll be able to earn and use your coins to purchase them in the market! 

[h2]Loading Screen[/h2]
We're updating our outdated loading screens to something a lot more fun and suiting for the game! Stay tuned for that coming soon! 

[h2]Steampunk Speedway[/h2]
There's a brand new level on the way! Named by our [url=https://discord.gg/7JH9ZKT]Discord[/url] community, Steampunk Speedway is the next track coming to Rocket Rumble. Featuring tons of gears and new track elements; we can't wait for this level to be available to play! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/68cc69adc44a7cd2e618fc0186308aa0683dbf8b.png[/img]

[h2]New Logo[/h2]
We're not quite ready to show it off just yet, but Rocket Rumble is getting a brand new logo! Keep your eyes peeled for our new branding, coming soon! 

[h2]Events[/h2]
We'll be attending some events this year starting with the Indie Live Expo later this month! Stay tuned for info on more upcoming events, coming soon! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/3d0b4c9f7a7342d0b16c9ba3ead8ef4812886fa3.png[/img]

We have a lot of content coming to Rocket Rumble over the next few months! Be sure to add Rocket Rumble to your Steam Wishlist to get updated! Plus, check out our Twitter and Instagram pages for more including giveaways, #WishlistWednesday threads and more! 



See you at the start line! 


-Rocket Rumble Team

notes.title: More Visual Updates and Track Randomizations!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! We're back with another small update to Rocket Rumble! Our Art team has been working hard on some cool stuff (some of which we can't show you yet!). They have also been doing some makeovers to all of our tracks! Here’s a list of some of the changes in the current game:

[list]
[*]New Post Processing Effects and color grading in Asteroid Field, Caustic Canyon, and Holo Night
[*]Improved Visual Effects on Player Characters.
[*]New Finish Line Cut Scenes and Track Transitions.
[*]Brand new randomized track chunks for Holo Night! Plenty more combinations to race on! 
[*]The Player Profile Banner now has its own 3D menu. Customize your border and banner in a whole new dimension.
[*]Various UI bug fixes
[*]Memory and code optimizations
[*]More Sound effects
[/list]


[b]Known Bugs: [/b]

[list]
[*]Finish line cutscene sometimes plays after score screen animations
[*]Characters occasionally invisible during finish line cutscene 
[*]Projectiles don't move up ramps correctly
[/list]

We hope you guys enjoy the current changes but stick around for some bigger updates, and new systems coming soon to our game!

Oh yeah and we also fixed some bugs...

[list]

[*] Fixed Bug where after a first local race, the track selection on the Track Vote Menu would not refresh for each local race thereafter.
[*] Optimized some online interaction in the menu transitions.
[*] Other minor bug fixes and optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: Love Struck
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/0f8453a672d371292cc105e540ba9e6ac7cb625e.png[/img]

[h2]Love is in the air...[/h2]


[b]Love Stuck [/b]is a brand new Valentine's Event coming to Rocket Rumble! From February 10th to 27th, you can join in the heartfelt fun right here on Steam.

The event features 4 brand new Valentine's missions which will unlock excusive Valentine's loot! Plus, collect candy hearts while racing which you can redeem for more exclusive items in the Rocket Rumble shop! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/dff290389b004c935fc0d73614c665ab2f43329e.png[/img]

There's [b]9[/b] new items to collect in all and they're only available for a limited time! 





We can't wait to share this Valentine's event with all of you! 

-Rocket Rumble Team

Plus, collect candy hearts while racing which you can redeem for more exclusive items in the Rocket Rumble shop!

notes.title: January Dev Blog
notes.content:
Hey Rocket Rumblers!

After the holiday break we're back and working hard towards the next Rocket Rumble update. Coming next month, our planned update includes a Valentines event, further upgrades to the menus and more! 

[h3]February is Coming..[/h3]
 
And that means Valentines Day is right around the corner! We've been working on a Valentines event that we can't wait to share! The event will feature new event themed missions which of course means brand new cosmetics to earn! The dates will be announced soon so stay tuned for more information! 

[b]Here's a teaser for one of our exclusive Valentines items:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/0e8f679edfd211bc78778bcf4af3a01c7b8369d8.png[/img]

[h3]Menu Improvements[/h3]

[h3]Gameplay Polish[/h3]

We've also been working on some overall polish to the gameplay, to make the experience a little smoother! As always we'd love to hear your feedback at any stage of development! We're looking forward to our next update and we're excited for more things to come! 



See you at the start line

-Rocket Rumble Team

notes.title: Holiday Hustle
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/f2d0c7c905c1a3728fc76ef8d22cbb92db78604b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/12e9e9f2c3e3bc8986d735317e83ab01c6d0c97e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dev Blog #4
notes.content:
[h3]We've been working on some [b]BIG[/b] things! [/h3]

[h3]New Demo[/h3]
We recently released a demo version of Rocket Rumble! Now you can try out the game with limited features, for [b]free! [/b] Featuring one character and 3 missions, demo players can queue for online matches or try out the tutorial! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/e00fcd9ad80d8cb3a88233c9abfadd3c2126738e.png[/img]
[h3]
Our Halloween even has ended! [/h3]
We just wanted to say thank you to everyone who made our Harrowing Halloween event a success! We loved seeing players earn the Halloween exclusives and we can't wait to keep building on in-game events in the future !

After finishing up our Harrowing Halloween event, we've been working towards our next big update - coming later this month! 

[h3]A brand new track is on the way!  [/h3]
Introducing [b]Holo Night[/b]: Our newest neon themed track! Avoid all-new holographic obstacles while you race through this synthwave inspired world! Featuring neon pillars and tiered ramps, this track is the first of several new worlds in the works! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/ada163472fee6d9b129d1edfb0c00dc30d5f8d8f.png[/img]

[h3]New Cosmetics! [/h3]
With this new track, we'll be releasing a ton of new holo-themed customization items for your characters! New badges, hats, ties and more are on the way! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/4d238e840480b56bd11f641acdd325cd42851e48.png[/img]

[h3]A Holiday event is coming in December! [/h3]
We can't spill too much just yet, but we have a new event on the way! It'll feature new holiday themed cosmetics and profile customizations, plus we've been working a brand new feature that we can't wait to share! 


More coming soon! Stay tuned! 

-Rocket Rumble Team

notes.title: Demo Incoming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/e00fcd9ad80d8cb3a88233c9abfadd3c2126738e.png[/img]

[h3]Take on players from all over the world in our brand new demo version of Rocket Rumble! [/h3]

Play as our lovable corgi, Pepper, as you race your way through fantastic sci-fi levels! Challenge random players to a Quick Play match, or load up the tutorial to learn the ropes!

notes.title: Dev Blog #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/8948ab1b6772ad5e9058236e5e44dd10d0f5d195.png[/img]

[h2]It's finally fall![/h2]

First of all we'd like to thank everyone that joined us at Game Slice and the Tokyo Game Show in September! Last month was busy for the Rocket Rumble team and we had a blast at these events! We're so proud to have been a finalist for the Game Slice Industry Choice Awards this year and to have been selected for TGS! 

[h3]Our first event was a success! [/h3]
We has a ton of fun with our Sweet September event! We had a few bugs early on, but it was a chance to work out some kinks to make our next event event better! Next time will be less of a grind to earn the event rewards. We learned that playing 30 matches is too many! 

[h3]Halloween is coming to Rocket Rumble [/h3]
We're excited to announce that we'll be holding a Halloween event this year! We're taking what we learned from Sweet September and we're coming back with a brand new event! [b][i]Harrowing Halloween[/i][/b] will feature new spooky missions and a ton exclusive Halloween cosmetics to unlock! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/e62f0f266a8f4cec45629eb8739c483e535fb994.png[/img]

Having a cool costume is what Halloween is all about! Here's a sneak peek at some brand new spooky items to dress up your racers! But that's not all that's getting haunted makeover! Expect to see some fun Halloween décor out on the track! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/830424141c889ada73ccee3ae87696add60a91db.png[/img]

[h3]Loot drops are getting a lot more exciting! [/h3]
We've been working on a fun new way to get loot! Instead of a lackluster pop-up you'll get an inventory of gifts to open!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/6fb095ba0a1061494aafcc17b4744932067ad6b7.gif[/img]

A little further away, but still exciting news! We've got a brand new character and track on the way as well as a brand new tutorial level! More on that to come in our next dev update! 

Lots of exciting things to come! 

-Rocket Rumble Team

notes.title: Sweet September Update
notes.content:
We've been working hard on some BIG updates to Rocket Rumble! 

[h3]Missions[/h3]
Embark on Mission Chains of premade missions to unlock specific rewards. The mission system tracks tons of fun stats for a large variety of mission types such as:
[list]
[*] Number of matches played
[*] Kills
[*] Item hits
[*] Wins
[*] Characters used
[*] Number of checkpoints passed
[*] Tracks

In the heat of the race, it was easy to lose track of your character! We've added a health indicator under your racer to help keep track of your character and your heath!

Checkpoints now do a little animation and change color when the first player passes them!

notes.title: Dev Blog #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/db073326a2dea9a3cac6de23013d782760bf607b.png[/img]

It's been just over 2 weeks since we launched Rocket Rumble into Early Access and development hasn't slowed down. Thanks to our awesome community, we've been able to find and squash some pretty big bugs and now we're working towards some sweet new content! 

[h3]The Pirate Bay got a facelift! [/h3]
Our latest track recently received a little overhaul! Going into Early Access, the track was a bit chaotic and  in some cases hard to maneuver through. Now it's looking and feeling a lot better! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114174/7c3ee551bef4e2e301bf14b30e82dd64bc285d77.png[/img]

[h3]Missions are coming really soon! [/h3]
We've been working hard to get a Daily Mission system up and running! Soon you'll be able to complete daily achievements for in-game rewards! 

[h3]Events?[/h3]
We're not quite ready to share more than that, but rest-assured we'll be having some themed events in the future so stay tuned! 

[h3]Changelog [/h3]
[list]
[*] Skip timer if all players have voted for a track
